description: Kujiondoa kwa kuelekezwa kwa FamilyTreeNow. Mtu hufuata hatua kwenye orodha ya ukaguzi; OpenOptOut hutoa anwani ya barua pepe ya mara moja na kubofya kiungo cha uthibitisho.
instructions: Search familytreenow.com for {full_name}. If you're listed, open familytreenow.com/optout and follow the steps to remove your record, using {contact_email} if it asks for an email address. Kisha bonyeza "Nimefanya hili".
